name: Marrige
overview: Scripture teaches that marriage is a sacred union ordained by God, where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24). This union is to be honored and preserved, as what God has joined together must not be separated by man (Mark 10:9). The Bible also calls for wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, reflecting the divine order within marriage (Ephesians 5:22). Furthermore, Scripture condemns sexual relations that deviate from God's design, emphasizing the holiness and purity expected within the marriage relationship (Leviticus 18:22; Romans 1:26).
